descriptionWindows: Strip down Windows — remove telemetry, bloatware, and unnecessary services
descriptionOther: Harden your system — manage privacy settings and unnecessary services

privacy.pageDescription: Control telemetry, ads, tracking, and data collection across your system
privacy.emptyStateDescription: Click "Scan" to audit your privacy and security settings and apply recommended hardening.
privacy.adminWarning: Some settings require administrator privileges to modify. Run Kudu as administrator for full protection.
privacy.ipcCallFailed: IPC call failed — try running as administrator

privacyCategories.telemetryDescription: Control diagnostic and usage data collection
privacyCategories.adsDescription: Block promoted apps, ad suggestions, and lock screen spotlight
privacyCategories.searchDescription: Keep searches local and disable web-based search features
privacyCategories.syncDescription: Control clipboard syncing, settings sync, and device tracking
privacyCategories.servicesDescription: Disable background services that collect and upload telemetry
privacyCategories.tasksDescription: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks running in the background
privacyCategories.kernelDescription: Kernel security parameters and memory protection via sysctl
privacyCategories.networkDescription: Network stack hardening and traffic filtering via sysctl
privacyCategories.accessDescription: Access control policies, SSH hardening, and system restrictions
privacyCategories.aiDescription: Disable Copilot, Recall, and other AI features that analyze your data
privacyCategories.browserDescription: Stop browsers from reporting usage data to Microsoft, Google, and Mozilla

privacyHints.telemetry: Telemetry sends usage data, diagnostics, and crash reports to Microsoft. Disabling it improves privacy but you'll stop contributing to bug reports.
privacyHints.ads: Windows shows promoted apps on the Start menu and lock screen. These are cosmetic ads — always safe to disable.
privacyHints.search: Web search features send your queries to Bing. Disabling keeps searches local to your device.
privacyHints.sync: Clipboard and settings sync sends data through Microsoft's cloud. Disable if you don't use multiple Windows devices.
privacyHints.services: Background services that periodically upload diagnostics. Disabling may reduce bandwidth and battery usage.
privacyHints.tasks: Scheduled tasks that run telemetry collection at regular intervals. Safe to disable.
privacyHints.kernel: Low-level kernel parameters that control memory protection and security boundaries. Only available on Linux.
privacyHints.network: Hardens the network stack against spoofing and redirect attacks via sysctl. Only available on Linux.
privacyHints.access: Controls SSH access, sudo policies, and system restrictions. Changes may affect remote access.
privacyHints.ai: AI features like Copilot and Recall analyze your screen, files, and activity. Disabling prevents local and cloud-based AI data collection.
privacyHints.browser: Browsers send usage statistics, crash reports, and feature telemetry. Disabling doesn't affect browsing — only background reporting.

debloater.pageDescription: Remove pre-installed Windows apps and OEM bloatware
debloater.irreversibleWarning: Irreversible — Removed apps can only be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store. Review selections carefully.
debloater.emptyStateDescription: Click "Scan" to find pre-installed apps and OEM bloatware.
debloater.confirmDescription: This will permanently remove {{count}} app(s). They can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store if needed.
debloater.scanFailedError: Failed to scan for bloatware. Make sure PowerShell is available.
debloater.removeFailedError: Failed to remove some apps. Administrator privileges may be required.

hints.safetyNote: These are pre-installed apps that most users don't need. Your personal files and settings are not affected by removal.
hints.removeAction: Removal uses PowerShell to uninstall the app package. Most apps can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store if needed.

serviceManager.pageDescription: View, manage, and disable unnecessary Windows services to improve performance
serviceManager.infoBannerUseRecommended: Use "Apply Recommended" for a safe one-click preset.
serviceManager.emptyStateDescription: Enumerate all services and identify which ones can be safely disabled to improve performance.
serviceManager.confirmDescription: This will disable {{count}} service(s) and stop any that are currently running. This requires administrator privileges.

hints.safe: These services are safe to disable on most systems. They handle non-essential functions like Xbox integration, print spooling, or fax support.
hints.caution: These services may affect specific functionality. Disabling Bluetooth services will prevent wireless devices from connecting, for example. Only disable if you're sure you don't use the feature.
hints.unsafe: System-critical services that Windows depends on. Disabling them can cause instability, crashes, or prevent Windows from booting. These cannot be selected.
hints.dependencies: The "Deps" column shows how many other services depend on this one. Disabling a service with dependents may cause those services to stop working too.
